title: Upgrade extension manifest
description: Manifest for `upgrade-extension.json` at the plugin's root. Identifies a plugin folder as an extension for the Upgrade orchestrator. The orchestrator scans the rest of the plugin folder for skills; under the proxy model the optional `mcp` field tells the orchestrator how to spawn the extender's MCP, and `enabled` / `traits` / `tools` gate which tools surface to the LLM. See doc/modernization-agent/extension-mcp-contract.md.

id.description: Globally unique extension id. Doubles as the Copilot CLI plugin id and as the value scenarios use in `requires-extension`.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in diagnostic output and (future) marketplace listings.

version.description: SemVer of the extension itself, independent of the orchestrator version.

mcp.description: Optional spawn instructions for this extender's MCP. Required under the proxy model when the extender ships any tools. Omit when the extender contributes skills only.

command.description: Executable to launch (e.g. `upgrade-dotnet-mcp` for a packed dotnet tool, or `dotnet` with arguments pointing at a DLL during in-repo testing).

args.description: Arguments passed verbatim to the child. Path elements may use the `${pluginRoot}` token; the orchestrator substitutes the manifest's plugin root at spawn time.

workingDirectory.description: Optional working directory for the child. Same `${pluginRoot}` substitution applies. Defaults to the orchestrator's cwd when null.

enabled.description: Extender-level kill switch. Default true. Set to false to disable the entire extender — the orchestrator will not spawn it and none of its tools will surface, regardless of `traits`.

traits.description: Optional trait expression gating which of the extender's tools the orchestrator surfaces. Evaluated against the orchestrator's resolved ITraitsSet when building `tools/list`, and re-checked at `tools/call` as defense in depth. Until the trait set has resolved the listing is permissive (every spawned extender's tools show); once traits are known the gate is applied. This gates tool *visibility* only — it does not by itself stop the extender from being spawned (use `enabled: false` for that). Grammar: atom (`X`), OR (`X | Y`), AND (`X & Y` or `X + Y`), NOT (`!X`), parentheses. Case-insensitive. Null / empty = always applies.

skills.description: Optional skill-root path(s) relative to the plugin root. When present, these roots are loaded in addition to the default `skills/` and `upgrade/skills/` directory-convention lookups — all skill layers are merged and skill-id collisions are deduped by the aggregator. Use to ship skills under a non-conventional folder or to expose multiple skill roots (e.g. shared base + scenario-specific). Paths that resolve outside the plugin root are rejected.

tools.description: Optional per-tool gate overrides. Keys are the extender's own unprefixed tool names. Tools not listed inherit only the extender-level gates. A tool listed here is visible IFF the extender-level `enabled` + `traits` allow AND the per-tool `enabled` + `traits` allow (intersection).

enabled.description: Per-tool kill switch. Default true. Set to false to hide a specific tool unconditionally.

traits.description: Optional additional trait expression layered on top of the extender-level expression. Same grammar.
